description: Building TerraRotate, a global NASA POWER & SMAP powered crop rotation and soil resilience engine
summary: A global, FAO-calibrated decision support system fusing live NASA POWER agroclimatology and MODIS Terra satellite imagery to score sustainable crop rotations (0–100) and eliminate bare-soil vulnerability.
details:
OVERVIEW

TerraRotate (powered by the AgriSync Engine) is an open-access, edge-first agricultural decision support web application designed for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge ("Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data"). It translates complex NASA Earth Observation telemetry into clear, explainable 3-season crop rotation recommendations for farmers and agricultural extension officers worldwide.

HOW IT WORKS & NASA DATA INTEGRATION

1. Live NASA POWER Agroclimatology API: Dynamically fetches 12-month peak temperature (T2M_MAX), corrected precipitation (PRECTOTCORR), and root-zone soil wetness (GWETPROF) for any selected farm coordinate on Earth, paired with offline LocalStorage caching for low-connectivity rural regions.

2. NASA GIBS Satellite Map Overlays: Integrates NASA EOSDIS Global Imagery Browse Services (MODIS Terra TrueColor) directly onto an interactive global GIS map so users can inspect regional vegetation and landscape context alongside field boundaries.

3. Explainable FAO-56 Multi-Criteria Scoring Engine (0–100): Rather than relying on opaque black-box predictions, TerraRotate evaluates three tailored rotation pathways—Plan A (Current Baseline), Plan B (Water-Saving Low-ETc Oilseed/Pulse Cycle), and Plan C (Regenerative Nitrogen-Fixing Legume + Cover Crop Cycle)—using transparent farmer priority weights (Water Saving, Soil Health, Market Profit, Pest Cycle Break, and Feasibility).

4. Bare-Field Vulnerability Timeline & Local Validation Flags: Visualizes 12-month canopy coverage to eliminate bare-soil erosion windows and explicitly flags regional grid uncertainties so farmers validate micro-field salinity and pH with local extension officers.

5. Accessibility & Voice-Enabled AI Agronomist: Features a global multi-language interface (English, Bangla, Spanish, Hindi, Arabic), Web Speech text-to-speech advisories, and an intent-driven AI Agronomist assistant grounded in the selected field's live NASA telemetry.
